paragraphs: This page groups the current public projects and older technical work.

AgenticCareerBoost is the current career proof workspace and site repository. P3CTeX is LaTeX/document tooling. AAAAT is future/separate job-search tooling. IronBank is older Java/Spring backend work from the banking simulation project.

items.title: AgenticCareerBoost
items.subtitle: Personal career workspace and public proof record: site, CV, reports, local workflow evidence, and correction history.
items.summary: Source-backed career proof record with public site, formal reports, CV material, selected logs, local renderer workflow, and static validation.

blocks.lead: This is the project behind the site: a public proof record for my career work and how I use AI-assisted workflows responsibly.
paragraphs: AgenticCareerBoost keeps the public website, general CV, formal LaTeX reports, selected history, correction records, and local career-workflow evidence together. It is intentionally not a generic product and not the development home for AAAAT or VCVGenerator.

The useful signal is practical engineering discipline: source-backed documents, static publishing, local/private data boundaries, a simple cover-letter renderer, and visible correction history when earlier automation became too heavy.

items.value: The site, public/general CV, reports, and selected logs are intended for recruiter or peer review.
application-tracker contains scratch tracker material and the simple cover-letter renderer used locally while future AAAAT/VCVGenerator work stays separate.
agents/state, agents/work/social, reports, and archived logs preserve representative history without acting as current instructions.
Private application data, tailored letters/CVs, raw offers, recruiter notes, generated private PDFs, and databases stay local and untracked.

paragraphs: Application Tracker is scratch/prototype evidence from my local job-search workflow. It is kept here because it explains how the current applications are generated and tracked until AAAAT and VCVGenerator exist elsewhere.

The public page uses fake data only. The valuable local workflow remains simple: keep private JSON under application-tracker/.private and run application-tracker/letter.ps1 <slug> to render a cover letter.

paragraphs: The current version is intentionally smaller and clearer. ACB is a career proof/workspace: public site, public CV, reports, selected logs, social research evidence, and local renderer workflow.

Old rules, tests, state files, and sprint notes remain as historical evidence, but they are not active operating authority. The root AGENTS.md and direct user instructions define the current boundary.
Future work in this repository should mainly improve the website and presentation. AAAAT and VCVGenerator are future/separate work, not part of this cleanup.

items.title: P3CTeX
items.subtitle: LaTeX tooling for reports, diagrams, listings, CV material, and repeatable document builds.
items.summary: LaTeX work for reports, CV material, diagrams, listings, screenshots, and document builds.

paragraphs: P3CTeX is my LaTeX class and package work for academic and technical documents.
It handles page structure, localized academic labels, code listings, screenshots, diagrams, covers, headers, report conventions, and CV/report builds.
It is source-backed document engineering for repeatable reports, CV material, and technical artifacts where the source and rendered output need to stay aligned.
